edges.reason: The lever marks the entrance hallway; brown carpet is visible further down the same corridor at Z=3-5
The brown carpet leads to a closed birch trapdoor at Z=6 that physically blocks the 1x2 passage
After mining the closed birch trapdoor, the player enters the room with white stained glass pane walls at Z=7-9
The white glass pane room ends at a solid yellow stained glass wall at Z=10 blocking further progress
Breaking the yellow glass at X=2 Y=1-2 Z=10 reveals a passage with cobblestone slab flooring at Z=11-13
The cobblestone slab passage ends at a solid black terracotta wall at Z=14 that must be mined through
Behind the black terracotta wall is the nether brick room spanning Z=15-18
The spruce button is mounted on the wall inside the nether brick room at X=3 Y=2 Z=17
The spruce button is in the final room before the chicken pen; after this area the player proceeds to the pen at Z=19-20

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The lever is mounted on the east-facing wall at spawn-relative [1,2,2]. Player must navigate near it and face it. Max distance 5 ensures player is in the entrance hallway. Facing tolerance 60° requires deliberate turn toward the left wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Brown carpet is on the floor at Z=3-5, target is the middle block [2,1,4]. Player walks forward through this area naturally. Facing tolerance 60° works since the carpet is directly ahead in the corridor.

Uses inventory_has because birch trapdoors are wood-type blocks that drop themselves when broken by any tool or hand. The two closed trapdoors at Z=6 physically block the 1x2 passage, so the player must mine at least one to proceed. The dropped item enters inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. White stained glass panes form both side walls at Z=7-9. Target is the left wall center pane at [1,2,8]. Player must turn to face the side wall. Max distance 5 ensures player is inside this room section.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because yellow stained glass does NOT drop itself without Silk Touch — it shatters yielding nothing, so inventory_has cannot work. Box narrowed to only the 2 passage blocks at [2,1,10] and [2,2,10] that the player must break to pass through, not the entire 9-block wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Cobblestone slabs are on the floor at Z=11-13. Target set at Y=1 (player eye-level) at [2,1,12] so facing check works naturally as the player walks forward, rather than requiring steep downward gaze. Facing tolerance 90° gives extra room for floor-level objects.

Uses inventory_has because black terracotta drops itself when mined with a wooden pickaxe or better. The player has a wooden pickaxe (given via /give command). The terracotta wall at Z=14 blocks the corridor, so the player must mine through it and the block enters inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. Nether bricks form the walls and floor of the room at Z=15-18. Target is the room center at [2,1,16]. Player naturally enters after mining through the terracotta wall. Max distance 5 ensures player is inside the nether brick room.

Uses inventory_has because spruce buttons drop themselves instantly when broken by any tool or bare hand. The button is mounted on the west-facing wall at [3,2,17] inside the nether brick room. Mining it causes the item to enter inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The chicken is in the enclosed pen at [2,1,20]. Max distance reduced to 4 to ensure the player has actually navigated past the nether brick room and reached the pen area at Z=19-20, preventing premature triggering from the middle of the corridor.

scene_description: A multi-room linear corridor building where the player progresses through connected rooms. Starting in a lit hallway with a lever on the wall, the player follows brown carpet through closed birch trapdoors, into rooms with white stained glass panes, past a yellow stained glass wall, through a cobblestone slab passage, past a black terracotta wall, into a nether brick room with a spruce button, and finally to a fully enclosed chicken pen. The corridor runs along the +Z axis from spawn, is 3 blocks wide (X=1-3) with a 1-block walkable center path (X=2), 4 blocks tall (Y=0-4), and 20 blocks long (Z=1-20).
task_text: Navigate through the corridor building: find the lever at the entrance, follow the brown carpet, mine through the birch trapdoor blocking the passage, find the white stained glass panes on the walls, mine through the yellow stained glass wall, find the cobblestone slabs on the floor, mine through the black terracotta wall, find the nether bricks in the next room, mine the spruce button off the wall, and locate the chicken in the final pen.
design_notes: Final revised scene with all critical fixes applied. Corridor runs +Z from spawn. Shell height raised to Y=4 for lantern clearance. Key fixes: (1) Both birch trapdoors set to open=false - physically blocks passage. (2) Four hanging lanterns at Z=4,8,12,17 provide lighting throughout. (3) Chicken pen fully enclosed with solid stone bricks (fill solid then carve 1x2 interior). (4) Center corridor explicitly cleared with air fill before obstacle placement. (5) White glass panes placed individually to ensure proper wall replacement. (6) Wooden pickaxe provided with 59 durability - only ~7 uses needed for all mining tasks. Command execution order ensures obstacles are placed AFTER air clearing.
